items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: They had two brothers. Yes, Johnny...

ctx.x: No, I don't know. Double. Down the corner. Brookhaven. I know all of Brookhaven. Can any of them down? No, I don't. That's probably it. That's it there. Might be not from Brookhaven. Brookhaven, yeah. Yeah. Might be there. They used to have a big brass band, too. I don't know if they played with them. Richard, do you remember old man Mendelson that used to play piano from the neighborhood? His son's playing with the Dukes of Dixieland now. Yeah, Stanley Mendelson. The boy. Mendelson. Huh? Mendelson. Well, his…

He was from the neighborhood originally. I was going to ask about Joe Lala, too. Did he have a band? Yeah, he had a band. He was pretty cool in the right town. And... And... They had two brothers. Yes, Johnny... Johnny and... Johnny.
And the Majada boys. Sala Majada.
